item.title: About
item.description: I started my studies at Arizona State University starting in 2021, where I am currently working as a research assistant at the Yarger lab. I also conduct research with the Robotic Actuators & Dynamics Lab. Past Experiences Position Date Description Research Assistant at the Yarger Lab August 2023 - Present Developed numerical integrators for stochastic dynamical systems that lift timestep restrictions on producing the correct statistics at long times. Additionally, worked on various projects involving spider silk and cloud chemistry software.
